document.title: Terrorism: Activities and Functions of the Islamic Army's Military Committee, and Political and Sharia Committee; Process of Approving Terrorist Operations
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: CIA Intelligence Report on the activities of the Islamic Army's Military Committee and Political and Sharia Committee, and how terrorist operations are approved. Source: 9/11 Commission Report, Chapter 4, Endnote 3.

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Leader of the Islamic Army; final approver of major operations recommended by the Military Committee

mentions.quote: THE COMMITTEE... MAKES RECOMMENDATIONS TO BIN LADIN, WHO IN TURN MAKES THE MAJOR

persons.name: Abu 'Ubayda al-Banshiri
persons.role: Head of the Islamic Army's Military Committee (as of early 1996, per the cable's text)
persons.status_detail: Press reporting from June 1996 said he was killed in the May 1995 ferry disaster on Lake Victoria in Tanzania

mentions.quote: THE COMMITTEE, HEADED BY ABU 'UBAYDA AL-((BANSHIRI)), MAKES RECOMMENDATIONS TO BIN LADIN
ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTING FROM JUNE 1996, WAS KILLED

organizations.name: Islamic Army
organizations.notes: Bin Ladin's military establishment; has a Military Committee, a Political and Sharia Committee, and a Shura Council that considers sponsored operations and policies.

organizations.name: Islamic Army Military Committee
organizations.notes: As of early 1996, its main function was military and operational planning and maintaining Bin Ladin's military establishment.

organizations.name: Islamic Army Political and Sharia Committee
organizations.notes: As of early 1996, responsible for issuing fatwas.

organizations.name: Shura Council
organizations.notes: Operations or policy issues sponsored by the Islamic Army are brought before it.

places.name: Lake Victoria
places.significance: Site of the May 1995 ferry disaster in which Abu 'Ubayda al-Banshiri was reportedly killed.

events.description: Ferry disaster on Lake Victoria in which Abu 'Ubayda al-Banshiri was reportedly killed (per June 1996 press reporting).
CIA cable on the Islamic Army's Military Committee, Political and Sharia Committee and the approval process for terrorist operations.

key_claims: As of early 1996 the Islamic Army's Military Committee handled military and operational planning and maintained Bin Ladin's military establishment.
The Military Committee, headed by Abu 'Ubayda al-Banshiri, made recommendations to Bin Ladin, who made the major decisions.
June 1996 press reporting said al-Banshiri was killed in the May 1995 Lake Victoria ferry disaster in Tanzania, which conflicts with the cable's early-1996 description of him as head.
The Political and Sharia Committee was responsible for issuing fatwas.
Proposed Islamic Army operations or policies go before the Shura Council.
